title: Suitability assessment
description: One append-only suitability assessment (an assessments row). Key: content revision + profile revision + policy version + model + prompt version. A changed profile or policy creates a new assessment and leaves earlier ones in place. Disposition is a judgement, never a retrieval state; coverage shows how much content the judgement saw.

coverage.description: Coverage of the assessed content revision, copied so it is visible with the judgement.

matched_interests.description: interest_id values from the referenced profile revision.

evidence.description: Model-cited evidence: short verbatim excerpts from the content revisions this assessment saw (its own revision or a linked item's current revision). Muninn checks every excerpt against the cited revision's stored text before storing it and fills in the revision reference itself; a citation that fails is dropped. Absent when no citation survived.

stance.description: supports: the passage backs the item's claim or its relevance. contradicts: it undercuts them (a correction, a weaker result, a caveat).

item_id.description: The cited item: the assessed item or one of its linked items.

source.description: The cited content revision of item_id.

excerpt.description: Verbatim excerpt from the cited revision's normalized text.

note.description: What the excerpt shows, in the model's words.

prior_assessment.description: The earlier assessment of the same item this one re-evaluates, if any.
